project: AI-Powered Contract and Terms & Conditions Analyzer
execution_environment: Local Python/Jupyter kernel using the supplied archive. The updated notebook also provides a Colab ZIP upload workflow; the student's own Colab runtime has not been tested.
source_contract_pair_note: The selected PDF and TXT are two formats of the same agreement, not two independent contracts.

preparation.method: Structure-aware chunking with fixed-size 1000-character baseline; merge fragments shorter than 80 characters; maximum chunk length 3000 characters; long paragraphs fall back to fixed cuts.
preparation.content_note: Contains extracted contract text; not committed to public GitHub pending document-level redistribution review.

limitations: PDF and TXT are two formats of one agreement, not two independent contracts.
Only one agreement pair was processed; this demonstrates ingestion, not representative dataset evaluation.
CUAD contains commercial contracts and may not represent consumer website Terms & Conditions.
Rule-based heading detection may miss unusual clause formats.
OCR, multilingual processing, model training and clause-detection accuracy evaluation were not performed.
Check dataset release terms and individual underlying contract rights before redistribution.
